description:
Pre-flight gate for d06.8. Verify by grep that the conversion is
complete:

  1. Zero matches for the old callback shape:
       grep -rn "render(.*width)" apps/octo_pi_tui/lib | rg -v vdom
  2. Zero matches for the legacy Component behaviour callsite:
       grep -rn "@behaviour OctoPi.TUI.Component" — only allowed in
       components that have been migrated to the new render/3 shape.
  3. Zero matches for the custom-widget escape hatch:
       grep -rn "custom_widget" apps/octo_pi_tui/lib
  4. Zero matches for `OctoPi.TUI.Compat` outside its own module
     and tests.
  5. `mix dialyzer` clean; `mix test` 1251+ green.
  6. tmux smoke run: open the TUI, run a prompt with tool calls,
     scroll the transcript, open every dialog/selector, exit
     cleanly. No regressions vs current `main`.

When green, mark this ticket closed and unblock d06.8.
title: Final audit: zero legacy callers before adapter deletion
